settings.field_2: Indian beauty. A personal point of view.
settings.field_5: We believe beauty is personal. Dunamiss brings together everyday care and expressive colour, so you can build a routine that feels like you.

settings.field_27:
Dunamiss Cosmetics is an Indian beauty brand built around a simple
            idea: beauty should help you feel confident in your own skin.
            From everyday care to expressive colour, we create products that
            bring together thoughtful formulas and the joy of getting ready.
settings.field_28: Our approach starts with the person behind the routine: what you enjoy, how you express yourself, and the care you make time for. We want choosing beauty to feel considered, comfortable, and entirely your own.
settings.field_29: Created by women. Inspired by everyday beauty.

settings.field_32: Three ideas shape how we think about beauty and the experience we want to create.
settings.field_35: A beauty routine should be a moment of attention to yourself. We value thoughtful choices and clear information that help you find what works for you.
settings.field_38: A subtle finish or a bold lip: there is room for both. We celebrate self-expression without asking everyone to follow the same idea of beauty.
settings.field_41: Understanding your products is part of enjoying them. We encourage you to explore ingredients, application tips, and the details behind each formula.

settings.field_44: Dunamiss was founded by Mrs. Meenakshi Chauhan and Dr. Abhilasha S. Rathore. Their shared vision brings science, care, and an understanding of Indian beauty routines into the same conversation.
settings.field_49: With a background in microbiology, Mrs. Meenakshi Chauhan brings a scientific perspective to Dunamiss and its focus on thoughtful beauty.
settings.field_54: Dr. Abhilasha S. Rathore co-founded Dunamiss with Mrs. Meenakshi Chauhan. Together, they lead a brand centred on care, confidence, and self-expression, with a shared ambition to make everyday beauty feel more personal.

settings.field_60:
We bring science and nature together to create beauty products

settings.field_61: We believe an informed choice is a confident choice. Take time to understand a formula, how to use it, and where it fits into your routine. Our product information and beauty journal are there to help you explore.
